title: Israr Husain v. Pashchimanchal Vidhut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Suneet Kumar, J.; Brij Raj Singh, J.
disposition: Writ listed; licensee to decide objection under clause 5.6; Rs.10,000 deposit recorded.
headnote: In a pending writ against Pashchimanchal Vidhut Vitran Nigam Ltd., the Allahabad High Court recorded the licensee's statement that the consumer's objection would be considered and decided by a reasoned speaking order under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, taking clause 5.6 into account, accepted the petitioner's undertaking to deposit Rs.10,000 towards arrears, and listed the petition. Clause 5.6 was not construed.
facts: Israr Husain petitioned the Allahabad High Court against Pashchimanchal Vidhut Vitran Nigam Ltd. over a meter and billing dispute. On 2 November 2021, counsel for the licensee stated that the petitioner's objection (Annexure 8) would be considered and decided by a reasoned speaking order under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, taking clause 5.6 into account. The petitioner undertook to deposit Rs.10,000 towards arrears. The writ was listed and later adjourned on 4 August 2025 on an illness slip.

holding_units.topic: consideration of consumer objection pending writ
holding_units.holding: On the licensee's statement, the Court recorded that the consumer's objection would be considered and decided by a reasoned speaking order as per the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, taking clause 5.6 into consideration, expected within three weeks; accepted the consumer's undertaking to deposit Rs.10,000 towards arrears of electricity dues; and listed the writ. No construction of clause 5.6 was rendered.

principle_tags.application: The 2 November 2021 order only records the licensee's undertaking to decide the consumer's objection under clause 5.6 by a speaking order and the consumer's Rs.10,000 deposit; the 16 September 2021 and 4 August 2025 orders are pure listings. Clause 5.6 was not construed.

not_decided.point: Merits of the consumer's objection and any clause 5.6 meter-testing or assessment dispute
not_decided.note: Left to the licensee to decide by speaking order; the writ remains pending.
